// diagnostic

E3502

Build plan is invalid, build evaluation returned an error, or generated source could not materialize.

What

Build plan is invalid, build evaluation returned an error, or generated source could not materialize.

Why

One selected root entry owns one deterministic graph. Handles cannot cross build sessions, outputs need one owner, and generated Jet must become a real file before checking.

Fix

Fix the named graph node or generated module; inspect it with `jet inspect graph` and `jet inspect explain-build`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3502: tests/ui/build_plan_invalid.stderr.

Error [jet.BuildPlanFailed]: Build plan is invalid: action name `same` is registered twice
  --> tests/ui/build_plan_invalid.jet:5:12
    |
  5 |     _ := b.action("same", [], ["two"], ["sh", "-c", "true"], [])
    |            ^^^^^^
 Why: `build: fn` must return one deterministic typed graph whose handles all belong to that build
 Fix: Fix the named target/action/toolchain/probe and run `jet inspect explain-build` to inspect the graph
